c001.coordinator_notes: The equation specialist's prediction (a piecewise Clifford/T gate-cost definition) was rejected as unsupported and not used. I added standard Kraus formalism and a geometric expected-cost formula, labelled as background or inferred. No claim is made about having read the paper. The circuit built from this spec covers only a single attempt unitary and does not reproduce the paper's polynomial-time synthesis algorithm.

c002.coordinator_notes: The native prediction (a product C_alpha Rz(theta) S_y(phi)) was rejected: it is unexplained, and the abstract contains no such relation. I added equations eq_2 and eq_3 from background knowledge, and corrected the plan's norm-disc condition by including the sqrt2^k scale. The plan is a baseline comparator and does not reproduce the paper's RUS contribution, and the abstract does not support its details. I have not read the paper.
